name: Monagee
questions: BuyerIQ places this Eircode inside the OPW 1-in-100 river flood extent, and the ground is only a few metres above the Suir about 1.1 km west. Has the house, garden or the lane off the Camus Road (R505) ever flooded, and does the current owner hold buildings insurance with flood cover?
The listing gives both 1,153 sq ft and 150 m². Can you send a floor plan or room sizes so we can confirm the true floor area (we have used 150 m²)?
Is every room on one level? Which two bedrooms have the WC, and is one of them near a shower room that could suit older parents?
What heats the house besides the stove and fireplace (oil, LPG?), and how old is the boiler? 'All main services' — is that mains water and mains sewer, or a septic tank?
Can you send a boundary map for the acre? BuyerIQ shows the property as listed for about 216 days, while Daft shows 27 Oct; has the price changed?

ai.why: A €350k single-storey four-bed on about an acre of mature trees, 3 km from Cashel, with Thurles trains 25 minutes away. Pulled back to a plain 3 by a mapped river flood risk, only two shower rooms for six, no floor plan, and a 30-minute ED.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; the listing says 'Modern house with all main services'.

water.detail: Probably mains: the listing says 'all main services' but doesn't name the water supply.

sewer.detail: Not stated; 'all main services' is vague and a house 3 km out of Cashel may well be on a septic tank.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband — 102 Mb full fibre'); the listing only says 'Wired for cable television'. Provider not confirmed.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Listed on Daft as a bungalow, so all four bedrooms (two with a WC) should be on the ground floor, but there is no floor plan or room list to confirm it.

bedsNote: Two bedrooms with a WC, plus a home office/study
heating: Not stated beyond a wood-burning stove and an open fireplace
tagline: A four-bed bungalow on about an acre of mature, tree-lined grounds with Galtee views, off the Camus Road 3 km west of Cashel.

pros.detail: About €2,333/m² on 150 m²; stamp duty about €3,500, leaving room for upgrades.

pros.text: About an acre of mature, tree-lined grounds
pros.detail: Stated as approx. one acre 'surrounded by mature trees', with a deck and an attached garage; set about 110 m back from the R505 on a private lane, nearest house roughly 115 m away (OpenStreetMap).
Listed as a bungalow with four bedrooms, two with a WC, two reception rooms (stove and fireplace), a kitchen/breakfast room, a study and a utility.
About 5 minutes to a real town: Tesco, SuperValu, Lidl, pharmacies, GPs, the Rock of Cashel and Chez Hans (Best Restaurant, Tipperary, 2026).
Thurles is on the Cork–Dublin main line, roughly hourly, about 1h15 to Heuston; Limerick Junction is a similar drive west.
Cashel Community School (mixed, ~860 pupils) is about 3 km; Rockwell College (fee-paying, co-ed day places, reported 100% progression) is about 8.5 km.

pros.text: Lets well, and views of the Galtees
pros.detail: Cashel is a busy tourist town for summer lets; the listing cites 'Lovely views of Galtee mountains'.

cons.detail: BuyerIQ puts the Eircode inside the OPW 1-in-100 fluvial flood extent; the house sits at about 69 m, only ~3 m above the Suir about 1.1 km west (EU-DEM), so insurance and access need checking.

cons.text: Only two shower rooms for six
cons.detail: Two shower rooms plus WCs in two bedrooms; no bath mentioned. The family brief wants three full bathrooms.

cons.text: Floor area is uncertain; no floor plan
cons.detail: The listing says '1,153sqft / 150 sq.m approx.' (1,153 sq ft is only 107 m²). The room list fits 150 m² better, which we use, but there are no room sizes or plan to confirm it.
Tipperary University Hospital, Clonmel (all ages) is roughly 30 km by road; Cashel's own hospital, 3 km away, has no ED.
Only a wood-burning stove and a fireplace are named; 'all main services' doesn't say whether it's mains sewer or septic, or what the boiler runs on. BER C3, kWh figure not shown.

cons.text: Dated, and only one photo seen
cons.detail: 'Antique pine' kitchen units suggest an older fit-out; only the lead photo could be checked, so condition and light are unverified.

cons.text: Primary choice is thin for boys
cons.detail: Cashel's boys' primary is a DEIS Band 1 school; the small rural mixed schools (Golden ~85 pupils, Boherlahan ~116) have no inspection results we could read.
